title: El cafetal
goal: Pick coffee for a day and be judged on your speed
culture: El corte is the coffee harvest and it is the axis a third of the country’s year turns on. You are paid by weight, green beans ruin the batch, and the people who do this for a living will be four times faster than you by lunchtime.

beats.good: El corte is the picking. For a third of this country it is the axis the whole year turns on.

beats.es: Ahorita mismo. Agarre un canasto, pues. Pero sólo las rojas.
beats.good: Only the red ones. Green ones ruin the batch, and you are paid by weight — so the temptation is real and so is the rule.

beats.es: Y con las dos manos, si no, no avanza.
beats.good: Both hands, both sides of the branch, all day. The people doing this for a living will be four times faster than you by lunchtime.
Va aprendiendo from him, voy aprendiendo from you. It is the highest praise you will get on your first day and it is meant kindly.
